**![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcBwyCZYRBY0M21vm8-23Ijn0QVLYlZ3NxqwKG6OuZP4fvTLF_c3KYM2ocXazkbpBKmgfjLQhVPJnW-OTHtDPd3Oq16cKNqjNKJT-bZCuk3wcluTwxVUxtQOddHg5MF79hfVZHvUNN9PtLhDW1Kn7T-xGMQ?key=3kY1iqgnrszKNylrGDjrVA)**

**Aceh, 18 September 2024,** two students and researchers from the Smart Agriculture Research Center, Department of Agricultural and Biosystems Engineering, Faculty of Agricultural Technology, Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) participated in the International Conference on Agricultural Technology and Environmental Sustainability (ICATES) 2024. Dwiki Nugraha and Fahmi Aryo Majid had the opportunity to present research results focused on the development of systems and equipment for indoor farming, particularly implementation in plant factories: Smart Agri Plant Factory.

Dwiki Nugraha presented research titled "Development of Thermal Camera-Based Crop Water Stress Index Monitoring System in Plant Factories." This research focuses on developing a plant water stress monitoring system using thermal cameras, which aims to detect water stress earlier. By monitoring the water stress index, this system can help farmers in plant factories manage water use more efficiently, which is crucial in maintaining plant health and land productivity.

Meanwhile, Fahmi Aryo Majid presented research titled "Development of Smart Lighting Control System for Plant Factories: An Intelligent Approach." This research emphasizes the development of intelligent lighting systems for plant factories, designed to optimize plant growth through automatic adjustment of light intensity and spectrum. This system is expected to improve energy efficiency and plant quality, while also supporting sustainability in indoor agricultural practices.

Both of these studies demonstrate significant potential in developing technology-based indoor agriculture, which is highly relevant to global challenges such as land limitations and the need for food security. The innovations presented by Dwiki and Fahmi align with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), particularly in promoting sustainable agriculture and ensuring food production.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfFlaq7Fj0tMY-qnXys5-zkdspcOaJkuFdLWZLqSKc9-SzVGSfX5yUd2Oqi2bV_kXRLtBS_cGK4tpRy6EB-lty49UqUyr6ZtnXr7YH1_4VCDUJ3cB2NePlRvgym6V_63h7okT5nlWheM2otE7WtCyagx0RS?key=pSEwhAMLtsRxASYnP8xXCw)

ICATES 2024 was attended by academics, researchers, and practitioners from various countries, with the aim of bringing together innovative ideas in agricultural technology and environmental sustainability. The success of Dwiki and Fahmi at this conference is expected to be an initial step in developing more intelligent solutions for the future of sustainable agriculture.

The conference also highlighted the importance of collaboration among stakeholders in the agricultural sector to address pressing issues related to food production and environmental conservation. By leveraging technology, such as intelligent lighting systems and thermal monitoring, the agricultural community can work toward improving food security while minimizing environmental impact.

original.body:
**![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcBwyCZYRBY0M21vm8-23Ijn0QVLYlZ3NxqwKG6OuZP4fvTLF_c3KYM2ocXazkbpBKmgfjLQhVPJnW-OTHtDPd3Oq16cKNqjNKJT-bZCuk3wcluTwxVUxtQOddHg5MF79hfVZHvUNN9PtLhDW1Kn7T-xGMQ?key=3kY1iqgnrszKNylrGDjrVA)**

**Aceh,18 September 2024,** dua mahasiswa dan Peneliti Smart Agriculture Research Center, Departemen Teknik Pertanian dan Biosistem, Fakultas Teknologi Pertanian Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) mengikuti acara International Conference on Agricultural Technology and Environmental Sustainability (ICATES) 2024. Dwiki Nugraha dan Fahmi Aryo Majid berkesempatan untuk mempresentasikan hasil penelitian yang berfokus pada pengembangan sistem dan peralatan pada budidaya tanaman dalam ruangan (indoor farming), khususnya implementasi di plant factory – Smart Agri Plant Factory.

Dwiki Nugraha mempresentasikan penelitian berjudul “Development of Thermal Camera-Based Crop Water Stress Index Monitoring System in Plant Factories.” Penelitian ini berfokus pada pengembangan sistem pemantauan stres air pada tanaman menggunakan kamera termal, yang bertujuan untuk mendeteksi stres air lebih dini. Dengan memantau indeks stres air, sistem ini dapat membantu petani di pabrik tanaman mengelola penggunaan air secara lebih efisien, yang sangat penting dalam menjaga kesehatan tanaman dan produktivitas lahan.

Sementara itu, Fahmi Aryo Majid mempresentasikan penelitian berjudul “Development of Smart Lighting Control System for Plant Factories: An Intelligent Approach.” Penelitian ini menekankan pengembangan sistem pencahayaan cerdas untuk pabrik tanaman, yang dirancang untuk mengoptimalkan pertumbuhan tanaman melalui penyesuaian otomatis intensitas dan spektrum cahaya. Sistem ini diharapkan mampu meningkatkan efisiensi energi dan kualitas tanaman, sekaligus mendukung keberlanjutan dalam praktik pertanian indoor.

Kedua penelitian ini menunjukkan potensi besar dalam pengembangan pertanian indoor berbasis teknologi cerdas, yang sangat relevan dengan tantangan global seperti keterbatasan lahan dan kebutuhan akan ketahanan pangan. Inovasi yang dipresentasikan oleh Dwiki dan Fahmi sejalan dengan Tujuan Pembangunan Berkelanjutan (SDGs), khususnya dalam mempromosikan pertanian berkelanjutan dan memastikan produksi pangan.

![](https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfFlaq7Fj0tMY-qnXys5-zkdspcOaJkuFdLWZLqSKc9-SzVGSfX5yUd2Oqi2bV_kXRLtBS_cGK4tpRy6EB-lty49UqUyr6ZtnXr7YH1_4VCDUJ3cB2NePlRvgym6V_63h7okT5nlWheM2otE7WtCyagx0RS?key=pSEwhAMLtsRxASYnP8xXCw)

ICATES 2024 dihadiri oleh akademisi, peneliti, dan praktisi dari berbagai negara, dengan tujuan mempertemukan gagasan inovatif dalam bidang teknologi pertanian dan keberlanjutan lingkungan. Keberhasilan Dwiki dan Fahmi dalam konferensi ini diharapkan dapat menjadi langkah awal dalam mengembangkan lebih banyak solusi cerdas untuk masa depan pertanian berkelanjutan.

Konferensi ini juga menyoroti pentingnya kolaborasi di antara para pemangku kepentingan di sektor pertanian untuk mengatasi isu-isu mendesak terkait produksi pangan dan konservasi lingkungan. Dengan memanfaatkan teknologi, seperti sistem pencahayaan cerdas dan pemantauan termal, komunitas pertanian dapat bekerja menuju peningkatan ketahanan pangan sambil meminimalkan dampak lingkungan.
